clock.title: World clock
clock.doc: The world's time moves one step before the turn, so everyone sees the same time

scene_route.title: Who is here
scene_route.doc: Finds the characters at the player's place by location (only those present act)

s1_plan.title: S1 forecast (Jev)
s1_plan.doc: One Jev judgment: what the player means · whether each character moves and how deeply · the mood; without Jev, the fallback plan (everyone present acts)

player_gate.title: The player's line
player_gate.doc: The player's words as an attempt: what they try · whether they can know what they mention (runs before the characters act)

s2_souls.title: S2 characters act in parallel
s2_souls.doc: Characters present act at the same time at the depth S1 gave (silent / gesture / speak / act); those away take a beat where they are

followups.title: S1 follow-up
followups.doc: After the characters answer, one more judgment: does the host still need to ask anyone (if not, the ask tools are put away)

pack.title: Pack the world
pack.doc: The world the narrator reads, in one pack (places · people · state · recent events)

understand.title: Read the line
understand.doc: What the world says about each thing the player mentions (nobody vouches for what is not there)

gate.title: Pre-ruling / enter a layer
gate.doc: The rules rule this beat in advance (a referee) · force a layer when needed (an ambush on the road → combat) · fire async tools itself

mode_layer.title: Layer
mode_layer.doc: Inside a layer (combat · a dungeon) the whole prompt is the layer's, plus the layer's state

solve.title: Narration call
solve.doc: One model call writes the beat, calling tools as it goes (dice · map …) and waiting for the engine's answer before it goes on

verify.title: Verify
verify.doc: Each proposed change is checked against the registry and the rules; fixable ones go back for a rewrite (a few times at most)

apply.title: Apply
apply.doc: The changes that passed are written into the world (state · files)

deferred_fire.title: Async tools
deferred_fire.doc: Tools that are not waited for (map · panels) are drawn after the beat lands (so they show where things ended up)

settle.title: Characters settle
settle.doc: What each character present remembers after the beat (written into their own memory)

after_turn.title: After the turn
after_turn.doc: Wrap-up after the turn (pictures for new things · triggers)

ticks.title: Background units
ticks.doc: The economy · effect countdowns · characters elsewhere · the pack's own rules, each within its declared writes

land.title: Commit
land.doc: The turn is committed as a version and its beat events go to the front ends

params.turn.plan.confidence: How sure a judgment must be
params.turn.plan.react: When a character counts as moved
params.turn.plan.fallback_depth: How deeply characters act when unsure
params.turn.parallel.souls.timeout_s: How long one character may think (s)
params.turn.parallel.souls.escalate_at: When a character thinks one more round
params.turn.parallel.souls.escalate_turns: At most how many extra rounds
params.turn.parallel.souls.heavy_at: When the heavy path is taken
params.turn.parallel.souls.decide_conf: How sure a character must be to decide alone
params.turn.plan.pack_budget: Pack size cap in characters (0 = engine default)
params.turn.solve.max_ops: At most how many changes per beat
params.turn.verify.grounded_min: How grounded a change must be
